## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      7 avis récents mentionnent prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 2 sept. 2026 - 4 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Will_, 4 sept. 2026, 1/5: "Premium is $80 /yr and then they want an additional $99 /yr for meal plans. Crazy expensive."
            2. _Sean Kramer_, 3 sept. 2026, 1/5: "This app used to be great and stable but a few years ago Private Equity got their greedy hands on it. Now there are bugs galore for normal app functions while simultaneously raising the price for subscriptions to $20/mo. look elsewhere, this is a sinking ship."
            3. _A Yates_, 2 sept. 2026, 2/5: "Barcode scanning used to be included and now its locked behind a paywall. Also, there is no reason to include AI in this app. It's a waste of resources."
<!--/ir-theme-->
